title: The proof tier after example 289's engine changes, VF-018's three tests apart: every other ignored Rust test in release, none hidden by a failure
description: Runs the proof tier's command with cargo's --no-fail-fast and without the three heap tests VF-018 tracks (JBMC's timeouts, which no change here touches), as the jobs after examples 287 and 288 did. The change behind it is in the own checker (lib/src/bmc), which nearly every proof-tier test runs: in regex.rs the flags of a Pattern are formulas where they were a constant (the same formulas where they are constant), Pattern.compile(String, int) of a String that is no constant asks the solver whether it can only be a literal followed by '.*' before it stays the gap it was, and one '.*' that ends an expression no longer makes an input with a surrogate the JDK's call; Character.isLetter of an ASCII char, Logger.isLoggable below INFO, the logging levels below INFO as constants and IntStream.range are modelled where each was a gap or refused. The tests of what changed (the unit tests, claims, values, pairing, object_strings, string_literals, loops, conformance, value_parameters) pass inline.
expected: exits 0: every proof-tier test but VF-018's three passes

resources.notes: the same job after example 288 took 35m47s at 3.4 GiB peak

steps.name: proof tier, no fail fast, VF-018's three skipped
steps.run: JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 JVMCONTRACT_HEAP_TIME_LIMIT=1800 JVMCONTRACT_TEST_TIER=proof TEST_COST=proof cargo test --manifest-path lib/Cargo.toml --release --no-fail-fast -- --ignored --test-threads 4 --skip the_output_relations_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm --skip the_other_object_reads_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm --skip the_parameter_reads_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm
